usedFor: Awork holds projects and tasks, and Trello shows them as cards when “New Task” runs “Create Trello Card”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Awork, then “Create Trello Card” in Trello
bestTemplate.why: Each new task becomes a card, so the board stays in step with the project.

watchOut: “New Task” in Awork only fires for tasks with a project assigned, so private tasks never reach Trello.
